The clear_boot_tracer function is used to reset the default_bootup_tracer
string to prevent it from being accessed after boot
to init data. But since clear_boot_tracer() is called via the

column2: it races with the initcall for registering the hwlat

column1: tracer. If someone adds ""ftrace=hwlat"" to the kernel command line
on how the linker sets up the text
column2: the saved command line may be cleared

column1: and the hwlat tracer never is initialized.
Simply have the clear_boot_tracer() be called by initcall_lateinit_sync() as
that's for tasks to be called after lateinit.
